## One questionable over-correction (#89)

#89 (TSMC Q2 profit **results**, "jumps 77% beating estimates") was downgraded away from window
2463, whose seed is the TSMC Q2 **preview** ("Analysts Expect Record Revenue"). These are the
same scheduled earnings event; the verifier fragments preview↔actual because they share no
distinctive token (expectation vocab vs results vocab). Not clearly wrong under a strict
"same-instance" reading, but flags a second facet of 260716-01: the token floor both
**over-admits** (weak overlap) and **under-links** genuinely-related preview/actual coverage.
Recorded, not corpus-frozen (judged uncertain).
